title: Mobile Wallet Wrong-Wallet Re-Credit Remedy: Customer Hand-Over Card
content:
**Mobile Wallet** — the customer's choice to have a wrongly credited transfer re-credited to its own wallet.

## Situation and business effect
On a wrong-wallet error notice that Paloma has found in the customer's favour (a decision of error found), the customer may choose to have the money credited again to the wallet the transfer is addressed to. The tool `choose_wallet_recredit_d4ef146e` records that choice and sends the re-credit. Its effect, as the tool itself defines it:

- the choice is recorded against the notice (remedy `recredit`, dated today);
- the whole principal Paloma holds for the transfer is sent at once to the transfer's own wallet as a new credit attempt, at the rate and local amount given;
- the principal Paloma holds drops to 0.00, and the transfer moves to processing with its release moment set to now and its date available set to today;
- the customer can tell the recipient the money is on its way.

## Condition
The amount a wrong-wallet re-credit delivers is not fixed until Paloma's funding for that re-credit stands on the transfer's ledger.

Restated: while Paloma's funding for the re-credit is not yet on the transfer's ledger, the amount the re-credit would deliver is not settled.

## How it is invoked
The choice is the customer's own. The agent unlocks `choose_wallet_recredit_d4ef146e` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it; the agent reads the references from the Mobile Wallet lookups and passes them, with the quoted rate and amount, to the customer.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `wallet_transfer_id` | the reference number of the Mobile Wallet transfer the remedy is for, as the agent reads it from the Mobile Wallet transfer lookup | identifier |
| `related_case_id` | the reference number of the wrong-wallet error notice the choice answers, as the agent reads it from the Mobile Wallet case lookup | identifier |
| `credit_attempt` | the number of the re-credit attempt on the transfer, one more than the credits already sent on the transfer | integer count starting at 1 |
| `fx_rate_applied` | the exchange rate the re-credit converts at, as the agent quotes it | payout-currency units per 1 USD, 4 decimal places |
| `receive_amount` | the amount the re-credit delivers to the wallet, as the agent quotes it | payout currency, 2 decimal places |

## Return
A dictionary rendered as text with `case_id` (reference of the recorded choice), `remedy_choice` (`recredit`), `ledger_entry_id` (reference of the re-credit entry), `credit_attempt`, `amount_usd` (USD sent, 2 decimals), `fx_rate_applied` (4 decimals), `receive_amount` (payout currency, 2 decimals) and `status` (now processing). A receipt with both references and status processing means the choice is recorded and the re-credit went out.
